text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Do you know what day it is?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Why, of course I do!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is none other... than the day I was<n>entrusted with
my very first solo<n>errand!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? No way! That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, no, no, no! That's not it!Today's a special day for me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Umm... Is it the day you first ran in a<n>race, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, no, not that either! Hm, okay,<n>here's a hint—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We only jest—it was a surprise! My<n>teasing
heightened the suspense, did<n>it not?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us celebrate this joyful<n>occasion!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Urara! Here's to a<n>good year
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I got a little nervous there...<n>Happy birthday!
